question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"gold".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"appropriate" **in the question suggests that there is a specific correct answer.
 
• The options are different metals (copper, gold, iron, silver).
 
• The correct option is gold.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Copper **is a reddish-brown metal commonly used in electrical wiring.
 
• **Iron **is a strong, silvery-grey metal often used to make tools and machinery.
 
• **Silver **is a shiny, white metal often used in jewelry and coins.
